content:
Arjun: TL;DR from the Q&A: people asked for windows and who owns what for API runtime changes, Console features, and Optimize. Posting the owner timelines we promised.

Leah: API runtime (v2) schedule: internal canary next Wed, partner pilot ~3 weeks after, GA ~6 weeks post-pilot. We'll provide an opt-in header/param `X-Redwood-API-Version: v2` and `?api_version=v2`. No forced migration for pinned models.

Dani: For streaming clients, can you summarize breaking vs non-breaking? We have webhook consumers and server-sent events to worry about.

Leah: Short answer: mostly perf and framing improvements. Streaming will add an additional partial payload type for function args. Backwards-compatible behavior for 90 days after GA. We'll publish code samples and a migration guide.

Samir: Dedicated/Private customers worried about reboots and downtime. Any explicit SLA changes?

Leah: Dedicated: control-plane first, rolling node updates next. Most updates non-disruptive; we'll surface per-customer maintenance windows and opt-in scheduling. Private: packaged runtime delta + checklist for on-prem upgrades. SLA remains the same; extended support options available.

Maya: Console timeline please 4c8. Folks want per-route cost, rollout controls, and latency buckets.

Leah: Console beta (internal + pilot partners) starts Apr 22. Public opt-in beta mid-May. GA targeted by end of Q2. Beta features: per-route token cost breakout, p50/p90/p99 latency charts, and a canary manager with rollback.

Arjun: How does Optimize fit in? We promised integration in demo.

Leah: Optimize v1: batching/caching advisor -> internal alpha in ~2 sprints; public alpha by month-end. Quantization recommender (with model-specific quality deltas and cost estimates) targeted for Q3. Console integration (one-click experiments from Optimize suggestions) planned for late-May, concurrent with public alpha.

Dani: SDK changes? We'll need to bump libs in a few repos.

Leah: Minimal SDK work: `client.stream()` will emit a new `partial_function_args` event in both Python and JS. PRs to SDK repos will be opened right after internal canary. Old frame types deprecated 90 days after GA; enterprise extended-compat available up to 6 months.

EngOps Bot: deploy-bot: "canary: runtime-v2 -> alpha-cluster at 2019876560"

Arjun: Action list: 1) @Leah publish a short timeline doc + migration checklist by EOD tomorrow. 2) @Dani open SDK PRs and add quick migration snippets. 3) @Samir prepare Dedicated/Private maintenance notice templates and share with CS/Sales. 4) Product to publish beta invite flow and pilot criteria.

Leah: I'll drop the timeline + migration checklist in #eng and update the public roadmap entry.

Dani: I'll queue the SDK PRs and include webhook examples.

Samir: I'll draft the maintenance language and coordinate with CS.

Arjun: If anything from the town hall Q&A isn't captured here, paste it and we'll route to the owner. Thanks all :thumbsup:
